text:
Situation: Aprepitant 80 mg capsules at Corvale East have 71 on hand, covering 8.4 days. Corvale General holds 239 capsules (26.4 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 27 capsules (16 days). FDA's drug shortage list shows aprepitant is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The product label names Pharmathen International S. A. (FEI 3009961173) as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA issued a Warning Letter to that plant on 2026-05-27 and an import alert on 2026-04-23. FDA's shortage list does not include aprepitant as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal supply can cover the gap at Corvale East without external purchase. Corvale General can spare 47 capsules and retain at least two weeks of stock. Corvale Lakeside can spare 3 capsules and retain at least two weeks. External suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list and their labels name no identifiable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 47 capsules of 80 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 3 capsules of 80 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).

Not recommended: Purchasing from BluePoint Laboratories, Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA, or Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC at this time.
